core_idea: Generate fresh A Story of Two carousel concepts after rejecting the prior care/logistics/usefulness cluster.
tone: intimate, funny, soft, emotionally warm, premium, observational, but allowed to be messy, teasing, awkward, petty, and new-love nervous
target_audience: people who send relationship posts to their partner because the scene exposes a private behavior they recognize
must_include: a concrete lived behavior or incident, not a relationship lesson
a send reason from girl-to-guy, guy-to-girl, new-love, or married-couple everyday conflict
hard_rejects_for_this_restart: he remembers / she remembers as the main idea
he did not marry / she did not marry hook shapes
one partner as fool and the other as saint
multiple candidates with the same emotional engine
desired_process: raw situations first, hooks second, scoring only after variety is proven
